title: What Showmob is
summary: A working guide to reading, presenting, and building portable Showmob pages.

blocks.title: Ideas become useful web pages
blocks.body: Showmob turns structured JSON into portable pages that are easy to browse, present in place, theme, review, and share.

blocks.heading: What we are working in (and why)
blocks.body:
Showmob is the live product: a small Vite + React app that turns JSON idea pages into one shareable URL (showmob.vercel.app). Code lives at github.com/wyrmspire/showmob. It is intentionally thin — not Mira or Edgerite — so an idea can be shown without building a whole platform.

Why care: Chris needs a link that opens a readable page (and optional slideshow blocks), not another slide deck. Agents work here when the task is content JSON, renderer polish, publish filters, or thin data later — not when inventing a second architecture elsewhere.

Right now production only lists published pages; draft and preview JSON stay in the repo for authors. Theme audition is an author tool, not something every visitor sees on a share link.
